$comment: NPCs that fight each other (plugins/npcs/NpcRivalries.plugin.js). Every side of a rivalry is hostile to every other side. Ids from the cache; who fights whom from the OSRS Wiki. Other plugins add their own with the npc-rivalries:add event (God Wars Dungeon factions).

rivalries.name: Shayzien army and lizardmen
rivalries.source: Wiki Lizardman: 'the Lizardmen will automatically attack the nearby soldiers'; Lizardman Canyon: 'Soldiers are always engaging the lizardmen in battle'; Battlefront: 'where the majority of Shayzien soldiers fight the lizardmen'. Shayzien soldiers do not attack lizardman shamans, nor they them (Lizardman Canyon), so shamans are left out.

sides.name: Shayzien army
sides.$comment: Soldier (Lizardman Canyon) 6868-6871, Ranger (Shayzien) 8566 (Battlefront) and 11089 (Lizardman Canyon), Soldier (Battlefront) 8567-8568.
